column1: 🏥  Medical Intake Question Bank — Indian Patients
Hackathon Task 3 · Prepared questions for common patient complaints · India-contextualised

column3: Question (English)
column4: Hindi / Hinglish Version

column3: What is your main problem today?
column4: Aaj aapki sabse badi pareshani kya hai?

column3: How long have you had this problem?
column4: Yeh pareshani kab se hai?

column3: Did this start suddenly or slowly?
column4: Yeh achanak aaya ya dheere dheere?

column3: Is this the first time, or has it happened before?
column4: Pehle bhi aisa hua hai?

column3: Are you taking any medicines currently?
column4: Kya aap koi dawai le rahe hain abhi?

column3: Do you have any known allergies to medicine?
column4: Koi dawai se allergy hai aapko?

column3: Do you have any chronic illness (diabetes, BP, etc.)?
column4: Koi purani bimari hai? (Sugar, BP, dil ki bimari?)
column6: Diabetes / Hypertension / Heart / Asthma / None / Other

column3: Have you been admitted to hospital before for this?
column4: Pehle kabhi hospital mein admit hue hain iske liye?

column3: What is your age?
column4: Aapki umar kitni hai?

column3: What is your gender?
column4: Aap kya hain?

column3: Do you smoke or consume tobacco?
column4: Beedi, cigarette, gutkha, pan masala lete hain?

column3: Do you consume alcohol?
column4: Sharaab peete hain?

column3: Where exactly is the pain?
column4: Dard kahan ho raha hai? (Angulee se batayein)

column3: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
column4: Dard kahin aur bhi jaata hai?
column7: E.g., chest pain radiating to left arm

column3: How severe is the pain on a scale of 0–10?
column4: 0 se 10 mein dard kitna hai? (0=bilkul nahi, 10=bahut zyada)
column7: Use visual pain scale for illiteracy

column3: What does the pain feel like?
column4: Dard kaisa lagta hai?

column3: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
column4: Dard lagaataar rehta hai ya aata-jaata hai?

column3: What makes the pain worse?
column4: Kya karne se dard badhta hai?
column6: Movement / Eating / Lying down / Pressure / Cold / Heat / Nothing

column3: What gives you relief from the pain?
column4: Kya karne se aaram milta hai?
column6: Rest / Medicine / Heat/Seka / Cold / Eating / Nothing
column7: Seka (warm fomentation) is common in India

column3: Does the pain wake you up at night?
column4: Raat ko neend mein bhi dard hota hai?

column3: Since when do you have fever?
column4: Bukhar kab se hai?

column3: How high was the highest temperature?
column4: Sabse zyada temperature kitna tha?

column3: Is the fever continuous or does it come and go?
column4: Bukhar lagaataar rehta hai ya chadta-utarta hai?

column3: Do you have chills or body shaking with fever?
column4: Thand lagti hai ya kaampna hota hai bukhar ke saath?

column3: Is there sweating after the fever breaks?
column4: Bukhar utarne ke baad bahut paseena aata hai?

column3: Do you have a rash anywhere on the body?
column4: Shareer par koi daane ya laal dhabbey hain?

column3: Have you travelled recently to a forested or rural area?
column4: Haal mein jungle ya gaon gaye the?

column3: Is there anyone else at home with similar fever?
column4: Ghar mein kisi aur ko bhi aisa bukhar hai?

column3: Have you had dengue or malaria before?
column4: Pehle kabhi dengue ya malaria hua hai?

column3: Do you have pain behind your eyes?
column4: Aankhon ke peechhe dard hota hai?

column3: Where in the head is the pain?
column4: Sar mein dard kahan hota hai?
column6: Front / Back / Both sides / One side / Whole head

column3: For how long does each headache episode last?
column4: Ek baar mein kitni der tak dard rehta hai?

column3: Do you see flashing lights or blurred vision before headache?
column4: Dard se pehle aankhon ke aage chamak ya dhundla dikhai deta hai?

column3: Is the headache with nausea or vomiting?
column4: Dard ke saath ji machlaata hai ya ulti hoti hai?

column3: Does light or noise make it worse?
column4: Tej roshni ya awaaz se dard badhta hai?

column3: Do you have high BP (known)?
column4: Aapko pehle se high BP ki bimari hai?

column3: Do you strain your eyes for long hours (phone/reading)?
column4: Lambi der tak mobile ya kitaab dekhtey hain?
column7: Eye-strain headache very common in students

column3: Is the headache worse in the morning?
column4: Subah uthne par dard zyada hota hai?

column3: Do you have blocked or runny nose with headache?
column4: Sar dard ke saath naak band rehti hai ya behti hai?

column3: Since how long do you have cough?
column4: Khansi kab se hai?
column7: Cough > 2 weeks → TB screen in India

column3: Is the cough dry or with phlegm?
column4: Khansi sukhi hai ya balgam aata hai?

column3: What colour is the phlegm?
column4: Balgam ka rang kaisa hai?
column6: White / Yellow / Green / Brown / Blood-tinged / Red

column3: Have you coughed up blood?
column4: Khansi mein khoon aaya hai kabhi?

column3: Do you have breathlessness?
column4: Saanss lene mein takleef hoti hai?
column6: At rest / On exertion / Climbing stairs / No

column3: Is there a whistling sound when you breathe?
column4: Saanss lete waqt seeti jaisi awaaz aati hai?

column3: Do you have chest pain with cough?
column4: Khansi ke saath seene mein dard hota hai?

column3: Have you lost weight recently without trying?
column4: Bina koshish ke wazan kam hua hai haal mein?

column3: Does anyone at home have TB or prolonged cough?
column4: Ghar mein kisi ko TB hai ya lambi khansi hai?
column7: TB contact history — very relevant in India

column3: Do you cook indoors on a wood/dung-cake stove?
column4: Ghar mein chulhe par khana banate hain (lakdi/upla)?

column3: Where is the stomach pain?
column4: Pet mein dard kahan hota hai?
column6: Upper centre / Lower centre / Right side / Left side / Around navel / Whole abdomen

column3: Is the pain related to eating?
column4: Khaane se dard ka koi sambandh hai?
column6: Better after eating / Worse after eating / No relation

column3: Do you have nausea or vomiting?
column4: Ji machlaata hai ya ulti hoti hai?

column3: How many times did you vomit today?
column4: Aaj kitni baar ulti hui?

column3: Do you have loose motions / diarrhoea?
column4: Dast aa rahe hain?

column3: Is there blood or mucus in the stool?
column4: Potty mein khoon ya aaon aata hai?

column3: Are you constipated?
column4: Potty sahi se nahi hoti? (Qabz)

column3: Have you eaten outside food / street food recently?
column4: Haal mein bahar ka khaana khaya tha?
column7: Food poisoning, street food common in India

column3: Do you have heartburn / acidity?
column4: Seene ya gale mein jalan hoti hai? (Acidity)

column3: Has there been any yellow tinge to eyes or skin?
column4: Aankhein ya skin peeli ho gayi hai?

column3: Do you have swelling in the abdomen?
column4: Pet mein sujan / phoolna lagta hai?

column3: Do you have pain or burning during urination?
column4: Peshab karte waqt dard ya jalan hoti hai?

column3: How frequently are you urinating?
column4: Ek din mein kitni baar peshab aata hai?

column3: Is there blood in the urine?
column4: Peshab mein khoon aata hai?

column3: Is there difficulty starting urination?
column4: Peshab shuru karne mein takleef hoti hai?

column3: Do you feel your bladder is not completely emptied?
column4: Peshab ke baad bhi lagta hai ki pura nahi hua?

column3: Do you have back/flank pain with urinary symptoms?
column4: Peshab ki takleef ke saath kamar ya peeth mein dard hai?

column3: Are you diabetic? (Diabetes affects kidney and urine)
column4: Aapko sugar ki bimari hai?
column7: Diabetic nephropathy very common in India

column3: Where is the skin problem on the body?
column4: Shareer par problem kahan hai?

column3: Is there itching?
column4: Khujli hoti hai?

column3: Is it spreading to other parts?
column4: Kya yeh aaage phail raha hai?

column3: Are there blisters or open wounds?
column4: Chhale hain ya ghav hai?

column3: Did you use any new soap, cream or detergent recently?
column4: Haal mein koi naya sabun, cream ya kapde dho ne ka powder use kiya?

column3: Do others at home have the same skin problem?
column4: Ghar mein kisi aur ko bhi aisi problem hai?
column7: Scabies — highly contagious, common in India

column3: Are there white patches on the skin?
column4: Skin par safed dabbe hain?

column3: Do you work in a field / construction / water for long hours?
column4: Khet, nirman kaam, ya paani mein ghante kaam karte hain?

column1: WOMEN'S HEALTH (show only if patient is female)

column3: Are your periods regular?
column4: Mahina (MC) sahi samay par aata hai?

column3: Date of last menstrual period?
column4: Aakhri mahine ki taareekh kya thi?
column7: Essential for any female of reproductive age

column3: Is there heavy bleeding during periods?
column4: Mahine mein zyada khoon aata hai?

column3: Is there pain during periods?
column4: Mahine mein bahut dard hota hai?

column3: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
column4: Kya aap pregnant ho sakti hain?
column7: Critical before any X-ray or medication

column3: Do you have any unusual discharge?
column4: Koi andar se safed ya ajeeb discharge aata hai?

column3: Have you had any pregnancies? Any complications?
column4: Pehle pregnancy hui hai? Koi takleef?

column3: How is your mood / mental state lately?
column4: Aajkal aap kaisa feel karte hain andar se?
column7: Avoid direct 'mental illness' label — stigma in India

column3: Are you feeling very sad or hopeless?
column4: Bahut udaas ya nirasha feel hoti hai?

column3: Is there a lot of worry or tension in your mind?
column4: Bahut zyada chinta ya tension rehti hai?

column3: Has your sleep been affected?
column4: Neend sahi aati hai?
column6: Yes-fine / Less / Too much / Very disturbed

column3: Is there stress at home or work?
column4: Ghar ya kaam par bahut tension hai?

column3: Have you ever thought of harming yourself?
column4: Kya kabhi aapne apne aap ko hurt karne ka socha?
column7: Suicidal ideation — handle with extreme care

column1: PAEDIATRIC — ask PARENT or caregiver (for child patients)

column3: What is the child's age and weight?
column4: Bachche ki umar aur wazan kitna hai?

column3: Is the child vaccinated as per schedule?
column4: Bacche ke sabhi tike lage hue hain?

column3: Is the child eating and drinking normally?
column4: Bachcha khana-paani theek se le raha hai?

column3: Has the child had loose motions or vomiting?
column4: Bachche ko dast ya ulti ho rahi hai?

column3: Is the child passing urine normally?
column4: Bachcha peshab kar raha hai?

column3: Any convulsions / fits?
column4: Bachche ko mirgi ke jhatke aaye hain?

column3: Was the child born full-term and normally?
column4: Bachcha poore mahine mein aur seedhe janma?

column3: Is the child going to school? Any developmental concerns?
column4: Bachcha school jaata hai? Koi pichhadapan dikh raha hai?

column3: Do you have any falls recently?
column4: Haal mein girne ki koi ghatna hui?

column3: Do you forget things more than before?
column4: Pehle se zyada bhulne lagey hain?

column3: How many medicines do you take daily?
column4: Roz kitni dawaiyan lete hain?

column3: Do you live alone or with family?
column4: Akele rehte hain ya parivaar ke saath?
